pressureTriggered.name: VFX E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: a constitutive visual/readability event requires authored time-varying/effect behavior that existing material, lighting, animation and UI carriers cannot close
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: exact failing case survives owner-correct attempts and VFX has a distinct authored-source -> runtime-effect -> frame-consequence oracle
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new VFX front only after scope admission

pressureTriggered.name: Procedural Content E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: required habitat variation or iteration throughput becomes a measured blocker for the declared encounter/replay thesis
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: authored production cannot meet the required condition and generator/seed -> reproducible content -> encounter acceptance is independently testable
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new procedural-content front only after scope admission

pressureTriggered.name: Advanced Ecology Simulation E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: the declared encounter requires persistent multi-entity or environment dynamics beyond V-S1/V-S2
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: frozen systemic consequence requires distinct ecology state evolution, failure modes and oracle
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new ecology-simulation front only after scope admission

pressureTriggered.name: Photogrammetry / Capture E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: a constitutive visual/content requirement specifically demands capture-derived source material
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: capture/calibration/reconstruction has a distinct source -> editable asset -> runtime acceptance closure
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new capture front only after scope admission

pressureTriggered.name: Persistence / Save E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: a required replay/progression condition must survive process or session termination
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: terminate/relaunch/restore preserves declared authoritative state under exact versioned condition
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new persistence front only after scope admission

pressureTriggered.name: Localization E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: the admitted Human/product condition adds a required locale
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: versioned locale resources are selected at runtime and admitted locale can complete intended interaction without source-language dependence
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new localization front only after scope admission

pressureTriggered.name: External Distribution E2E
pressureTriggered.trigger: an admitted participant/provider condition requires the exact candidate outside the local/test boundary
pressureTriggered.admissionOracle: exact artifact identity survives declared external delivery/install/launch channel
pressureTriggered.ownerRoute: new distribution front only after scope admission

notes: A23/F25 Independent Product QA / Red Team remains judge-only.
A24/F26 Rights / Provenance remains separate from A23.
A21 owns telemetry plus Player Evidence/Human Playtest protocol and evidence transport; real Human participant is external evidence source.
A17 owns Engine Integration only; A25 independently owns player-interaction runtime.
A19 may route Workstation/Engineering defects but not absorb specialist ownership.
V-C1 generic Asset Authoring removed; editable-source authority stays inside concrete production E2Es.
P2 Authority / Admission covers Game↔Studio/Research/Engineering/Workstation cross-owner boundaries; no duplicate eighth authority plane.
